title: U.S. EPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) - Enforcement Case Search

operations.description: The get_case_info service end point searches for civil enforcement and criminal cases based on the provided selection criteria and returns either individual cases or clusters of case facility locations.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services case info [PARAMS] 1lat 1lon 2lat 2lon act actions activity ao area c callback case category cats citation city civil comp complying contact core cost county court cp criminal date desc district docket enf entered fac facility fed flg fntype from frs fy has id indicator law lead lodged map mapset milestone multimedia naics name number ocmap oeca order output p penalty pretty primary print priority program qcolumns qs queryset rank recovery region responseset role section sens sep sic state status summary to total tribal type usmex val violation voluntary zip [SCHEMA] 0 case cases cluster crs data info output qp results

operations.description: The get_case_report service endpoint returns a complex object of civil enforcement case details based on the provided case id.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services case report [PARAMS] callback id output p [SCHEMA] 1 activities and caed case citations conclusions crs defendants documents enforcement facilities information laws links milestones pollutants program related results sections

operations.description: The get_cases service end point searches for civil enforcement and criminal cases based on the provided selection criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services cases [PARAMS] 1lat 1lon 2lat 2lon act actions activity ao area c callback case category cats citation city civil comp complying contact core cost county court cp criminal date desc district docket enf entered fac facility fed flg fntype from frs fy has id indicator law lead lodged map maplist milestone multimedia naics name number ocmap oeca order output p penalty primary priority program qcolumns qs queryset rank recovery region responseset role section sens sep sic state status summary tablelist to total tribal type usmex val violation voluntary zip [SCHEMA] 0 2 cases crs data map output results
[METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services cases from facility [PARAMS] callback id output p [SCHEMA] 0 case cases crs facility from number numbers results

operations.description: The get_crcase_report service end point returns a complex object of criminal case detials based on the provided criminal case id.
operations.summary: Enforcement Criminal Case Summary Report Search
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services crcase report [PARAMS] callback id mapset output p [SCHEMA] 3 case cr crs defendants details information locations results

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_cases query, return a comma separated value (CSV) file of the cases found.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services download [PARAMS] output qcolumns qid [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services facilities from case [PARAMS] callback id output p [SCHEMA] 0 case crs facilities from id ids registry results

operations.description: The purpose of the GET_MAP service is to display facility coordinates and facility clusters related to a get_cases query. Currently, the maximum number of coordinates returned is 500. GET_MAP performs automatic clustering at the state, county, and zip code levels to maximize the number of coordinates returned.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services map [PARAMS] 1 2 c callback lat long output qid tablelist [SCHEMA] 0 crs data map output

operations.description: GET_QID is passed with a query ID corresponding to a previously run get_cases query. It then returns a CASES object containing all matching cases. The main purpose of GET_QID is for large querysets that contain multiple pages (responsesets) of output. GET_QID allows for pagination and for the selection and sorting of columns.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services qid [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output pageno qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 0 5 cases crs results

operations.description: Returns the JSON Object Name and ColumnId for usage with the qcolumns parameter for get_cases endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] case rest services metadata [PARAMS] callback output [SCHEMA] 1 2 met

operations.description: Returns the ICIS Law Section Descriptions.
operations.summary: ECHO ICIS Law Sections Lookup Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rest lookups icis law sections [PARAMS] callback code flag order output search sort status statute term [SCHEMA] 00 51 lu results rlk values
